items.title: US Yields, Crude Oil prices cool | Tata Group Stocks In Focus on Tata Sons Tata Trusts Split
items.description: Wall Street rallied on Thursday, with the Dow gaining 0.6%, the S&P 500 rising 1.1% and the Nasdaq surging 1.7%, as lower US Treasury yields and easing oil prices supported risk appetite. The US 10-year yield pulled back to 4.73%, while the 30-year and 2-year yields also declined. Brent crude eased to around $105 a barrel, with Saudi Arabia reportedly sending crude through ship-to-ship transfers. In India, the Nifty rose for the second straight day, while the Sensex ended slightly lower. Midcaps rebounded strongly, with the Midcap index gaining 1%. FIIs remained net sellers, offloading ₹3,208.76 crore in equities, while DIIs were net buyers with purchases worth ₹3,617.75 crore. Tata Group stocks are likely to remain in focus after Tata Sons reappointed N Chandrasekaran as Chairman. The move has also triggered public disagreement from Tata Trusts over his reappointment and the proposed listing of Tata Sons.
